mentions.name: Vibecoded game framework
mentions.description: A game framework for vibecoded games. Native APIs are exposed via Rust, while the core framework, games, mods, and libraries are written in AssemblyScript. It builds as a binary that runs on PC, mobile, and web platforms, and when launched provides a claude-code-like console with access to a sandboxed filesystem for game code and a built-in git repo.
mentions.audience: vibecoders writing games with AI assistance
mentions.source_excerpt:
A game framework for vibecoded games.

Native APIs exposed via Rust, but the core framework is written in AssemblyScript. Games or mods/libraries built in it are also written in AssemblyScript.

It builds as a binary that can run on the various PC, mobile, and web platforms. You run it and you get a claude-code-like console that has access to a sandboxed filesystem to put game code in, and a git repo, all built in.
